title: redact.redact leaves password=, secret= and api_key= assignment values in text, so they reach the spool comment and the distill call
goal: redact.redact replaces with the secret placeholder, keeping the key, the value of a key=value, key: value, JSON "key": "value", prefixed environment line (DB_PASSWORD=v) and URL query (?api_key=v) assignment whose key is password, passwd, pwd, secret, client_secret, api_key, apikey, x-api-key, access_key or secret_access_key, alone or as the end of a longer key (aws_secret_access_key, a connection string's Password=), whatever the value's length or entropy, except a value that is already a placeholder (<...>, ${...}, $NAME, %NAME%, ***); a second pass changes nothing and the ordinary sample stays unchanged; the committed query log store still passes querylog.py check; the planted input of test_redact.py's first test holds each of these assignment forms

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import redact as R;v='Fake'+'Pass12345x';w='Fk'+'12ab';q=chr(34);forms=['password='+v,'passwd: '+v,'pwd='+w,'secret='+v,'{'+q+'client_secret'+q+': '+q+v+q+'}','DB_PASSWORD='+v,'api_key='+v,'apikey: '+v,'x-api-key: '+v,'https://api.example.com/v1?api_key='+v+'&page=2','aws_secret_access_key='+v+'/x+y','access_key='+v,'Server=db.example.com;Password='+v+';'];o=R.redact(chr(10).join(forms));left=[f for f,l in zip(forms,o.split(chr(10))) if v in l or w in l];print('left:',len(left),'of',len(forms));sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

import sys;t=open('_tools/test_redact.py',encoding='utf-8').read();need=['passwd','client_secret','api_key','x-api-key','secret_access_key','Password=','DB_PASSWORD'];miss=[n for n in need if n not in t];print('missing in test_redact.py:',miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

gates.question: Where do the new assignment shapes live: in redact.py's rules only, leaving the committed-file leak scan's shape list (kbcommon) as it is, or in that shared list too? The plan probe found about 159 assignment-like lines in tracked files today (code such as 'x = path.read_text', docs, the reviewed allowlist), which a shared shape would flag in the suite and the sync gate.

notes: Found by the SP-ficl7pxl review (ST-h3y6iym4 leak scope; the exposure predates the sprint). Widened by the SP-yyjwfjtc plan probe on origin/main b97cd6ebf: every unquoted, colon, JSON, prefixed-env and URL-query form of password/passwd/pwd/secret/client_secret/api_key/apikey/x-api-key passes redact.redact unchanged; aws_secret_access_key=v is cut at its first / so the part before it stays; only the quoted password='v' of 8+ characters (kbcommon.SECRETS) is caught.
